verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee offers markdown output (return_page_markdown), AI-based extraction (ai_query), and handles JS rendering/blocking via headless browsers and premium proxies, directly addressing clean text and anti-blocking needs. However, it lacks a dedicated 'LLM-ready' pipeline (no full text-cleaning/summarization mode), and community feedback highlights cost concerns rather than output quality, so evidence of full clean-text delivery is partial.
